                                    • API reference
                                      • Overview
                                      • Meta
                                        • Overview
                                        • Build identity and corpus statistics (version, commit, counts).
                                      • Scripture
                                        • Overview
                                        • Every verbatim line of one Ang, with its raag, section, authors and the composition it continues.
                                        • Every verbatim line of one composition, heading run included.
                                        • A complete structural unit (Hukam) chosen at random.
                                        • Verbatim lines by id (used to repair saved Study-Trail pins).
                                      • Search
                                        • Overview
                                        • Search the Granth through the ranked waterfall (exact FTS, seeker lexicon, variants, English, passage, fold).
                                        • Occurrences of one Gurmukhi word.
                                      • Verify
                                        • Overview
                                        • Is this quotation really in the Granth? Returns a verdict, confidence and the matched line.
                                      • Insights
                                        • Overview
                                        • Theme co-occurrence network (PPMI + Jaccard).
                                        • Author stylometry list, or one author's profile (radar fingerprint + distinctive terms).
                                        • Raag analytics list, or one raag's profile.
                                        • Theme progression through one raag (binned).
                                        • Author resonance chord (semantic-neighbour lift between authors).
                                        • The 22 Vaars.
                                        • One Vaar's anatomy (pauris and saloks, attributed).
                                        • Concept constellation: verses carrying a concept, clustered by co-concept.
                                        • Related compositions (theme-profile cosine).
                                        • Concepts carried by each line (Study Trail).
                                        • Semantic neighbours of a line (exact sparse cosine; relatedness bands in the UI).
                                      • Knowledge
                                        • Overview
                                        • Raag-timing claims on the pahar clock (attributed claims, never facts).
                                        • Timing claims for one raag, with sources.
                                        • Raags whose sources disagree on timing (divergence preserved, never adjudicated).
                                        • Structural, poetic and musical form metadata for one composition.
                                      • Nitnem
                                        • Overview
                                        • The Nitnem / Gutka bani registry.
                                        • One bani's lines (SGGS lines by pointer, cited by Ang; labelled extra layer).
